blocks.text: Memo: keep MySQL for stock, Mongo only for catalog extras

This is the working cut for LSH-MEM-2023-041 on August 10, 2023. Luis Ortega asked for a written bound after the current path (MySQL replica for stock, no Mongo in prod) stopped being honest. I am Michael Gilfilian, Web Developer, writing for Luis Ortega, Cole Brennan, and Mara Singh. Primary host mysql-ro.lakeshore.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on on-hand in Mongo, then open questions. If you are implementing next week, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the commands or contracts.

MySQL stays the stock ledger. Mongo may hold product copy and photos. Reject moving on-hand to Mongo. I am not restating a hallway yes. on-hand in Mongo is out because Contractors like documents. Store managers like a row they can sum. Mara needs SQL for month-end. Mongo is not that row. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: look at sku=18.4k, stores=4, year1=3.6, weeks=0, ledger=1, monthend=16:00, nails=1, replica=1. Sibling tickets LSH-4880 and LSH-TDD-2022-022. I will not reopen on-hand in Mongo in a side thread because a vendor sent a discount. Cole Brennan is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.

blocks.text: Background. Why the current path is the wrong tool

Mara Singh owns a leftover that is easy to skip: inv-api.lakeshore.internal. I will ping once. After that the owner is late, not blocked. Unique to this file (32): refuse on on-hand in Mongo, lock is MySQL stock, Mongo optional for copy, no second ledger. I will not hide a product change inside a 'quick align' on LSH-4880.
I do not want two numbers for the same nail. Pick a ledger.

What a skeptical user would try first on mysql-ro.lakeshore.internal: the path Luis Ortega actually has, not a desktop demo. Metric I will argue is time-to-useful, not a vanity QPS. If we cannot show that path on mongo-01.lakeshore.internal with the numbers already in this file, we do not have a cut. Michael Gilfilian will not accept a laptop screenshot as that proof.

I will not claim on-hand in Mongo is impossible for a competitor. I will claim we will not buy it. I will not claim zero incidents after this cut. I will claim the next one dies at the gate named in the lock. Host mysql-ro.lakeshore.internal.
